name: kafka
notes: auto-create: no kafka_topic_config and auto.create.topics.enable=true — the broker creates the topic with its default partition count; records are keyless and land on partition 0

manual create: kafka_topic_config num_partitions=2 replication_factor=1 makes the sender create the topic via KafkaAdminClient.create_topics (the path for auto.create.topics.enable=false clusters); TopicAlreadyExistsError on re-init logs 'already exists' (kafka_sender.py:150-151)

consumer race: a subscribing consumer's metadata request containing the topic name auto-creates it on an auto-create-enabled broker with the DEFAULT 1 partition, so the manual-create capture waits for the sender's own create_topics (verified 2 partitions in the journal) before subscribing — probed: producer construction alone does not auto-create; a send() does
keying: a fixed kafka_msg_key pins kafka-python's default partitioner murmur2(key) % num_partitions — ALL keyed records land on ONE deterministic partition

compression: producer chose snappy (zstd preferred when zstandard is importable — blocked by the test shim because the deployment ships no zstandard, requirements.txt); consumer-side decompression is transparent

xerial framing: kafka-python's snappy codec compresses batches in Java-compatible xerial block framing (magic 0x82 0x01 0x01 + block table) — producer-to-broker detail invisible to the consumer; the sarama framing interop verdict is Task 22's
produce path pinned from source: per-message send() + flush() + future.get(timeout=1) must all succeed before mark_sent (kafka_sender.py:163-172); producer linger_ms=500
record timestamps are broker-assigned wall clock (excluded); headers are empty (the Python producer sends none); offsets are contiguous from 0 on the fresh topic
